notes.title: patch 2031501:weapon rules modified,ragdoll added
patch 2031501:weapon rules modified,ragdoll added
AI update,Controls Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29769141/94cb555c7f14c548c83154d64602b2ed2b0e3207.jpg[/img]
[h1]Controls Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]HTC Vive
[list]
[*]Left handle
[list]
[*]Moving is controlled by Trackpad now (Right handle can’t control moving)
[*]Pressing Menu button to exit
[/list]
[*]Right handle
[list]
[*]Attacking and interaction is controlled by Trigger button
[*]Switching weapons is controlled by Left Trackpad and Right Trackpad
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Oculus
[list]
[*]Left Touch
[list]
[*]Moving is controlled by Rocker now (Right Touch can’t control moving)
[*]Pressing Menu button to exit
[/list]
[*]Right Touch
[list]
[*]Attacking and interaction is controlled by Trigger button
[*]Switching weapons is controlled by A and B button
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Keyboard and mouse
[list]
[*]Moving is controlled by WASD
[*]Pressing Q to exit
[*]Attacking and scene interaction is controlled by left mouse button 
[*]Holding right mouse button to adjust view
[*]Pressing R to Reload
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Virtual positioning update[/h1]
We have optimized the system of virtual positioning. The problems of plyers’ height and wrong scale in VR scenes can be avoided after updating.

[h1]AI update[/h1]
The problem that zombies could not walk up and down stairs has been optimized. They can pass the stairs and attack players now.

[h1]Achievement fixed[/h1]
We have fixed the BUG of achievement. ‘Red point’ can be obtained now.
